title: Ploughman's Cheese Sandwich
description: A simple and classic British sandwich recipe featuring cheese, pickles, and bread. Perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: 1. Butter one side of each slice of bread.
2. Place one slice of bread, butter-side down, in a pan over medium heat.
3. Top with a slice of cheese, a few slices of pickle, and a sprinkle of chives.
4. Place another slice of bread, butter-side up, on top of the filling.
5. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
6. Flip the sandwich over and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
7. Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make additional sandwiches.
